blurb: Guests participate in meditation, yoga, breathwork, sound healing, energy healing, and ceremonial practices. Private sessions and group classes are available, including guided meditations, Reiki, yoga nidra, breathwork, sound baths, and cacao ceremonies. The Mindry also offers a 100-hour meditation teacher training program with in-person and virtual options.
